The wreckage of an ancient '''space station''' was discovered by ore prospectors on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Priceless Debris}}</ref>
